rv.q: Or, most likely, it’s the stellar performances and production values. Whatever the reason, this production of Frank Wildhorn’s 2004 musical is a remarkably fine mounting of a remarkably mediocre musical.

2 Kelly Krippendorf & Justin Meyer I suspect that the poor reception in New York was partly due to the show having originated on the West Coast (the Big Apple’s provincial chauvinism, you know), but there is the matter of a certain bar which I believe that musicals disregard to their peril. Consider the following: West Side Story , 13 songs.
